Moves an item from one provided slot within an entity's inventory to another

### Syntax:

```
/itemmove <targets: Player> <slot: Enum> <index: Integer> <destinationSlot: Enum> <destinationIndex: Integer> [moveMode: Enum] [replaceItem: Boolean]
```

### Permission:
